{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
